statement: R2 (owner S68, 2026-10-19). Program link: a value the newer reader typed is linked to a taught measurement by what both are (metric, kind, condition values), never by shared words; the most specific level wins; a candidate that would assume an unstated condition is not preferred; competition between candidates with the same consequences is immaterial (linked to each), otherwise the value stays ambiguous, with the condition axes that would decide; a value no taught measurement measures is reported as outside the teaching. Program evidence: graded evidential force (owner S68): direct, partial contribution, indirect indicator, force not verified, or relevant with its conditions not shown; an outcome is assessed by direct evidence, or by every contributing measurement the teaching lists (at least two), and otherwise only partly. Nothing here authorises a ranking: that also needs the user's need, the conditions of comparison and independent sources. Shadow only. lk.2 (owner S69): one observation, several analytical uses. A measurement of several measurand groups is an analytical set; a value describes at most one single measurement but may be a member of every compatible set; a member alone is only a component; the set's force applies to an aligned point (every group at the same required setting, compatible methods, not necessarily one run), and two or more points support a partial relationship; contributions that share an observation are not independent; one observation reported twice is one observation. lk.3 (owner review S70): an observation is identified by its provenance (source document), so equal numbers from two sources are two observations; an aligned point needs shown compatibility (one source's protocol, or a method stated by every source), and otherwise its compatibility is explicitly not shown; a direct relation through a measurement PEE cannot fully read is capped at partial. lk.4 (owner review S71): compatibility only from positive support (one identified test, or the same stated method, with every required condition stated); sharing a document or missing information is never compatibility. Observation identity only from an identified test; without it neither equivalence nor independence is assumed, and a set of contributions resting on unknown identities is not complete. A direct relation through an incompletely translated measurement has unresolved force, not partial. lk.5 (owner review S72): a protocol or a named test procedure supports compatibility (same_protocol) but is never the identity of an observation; identity needs an identified run. lk.6 (R3): among preferred candidates of one level, those whose fixed condition the value states are more specific and are chosen (most specific consistent hypothesis); otherwise every preferred candidate stays. A condition that partitions the candidates (two fix different values of it) and that the value does not state is the deciding question: the value stays ambiguous among them.

vocabulary.name: value
vocabulary.meaning: V is a value the newer reader found (a typed quantity).

vocabulary.name: value_kind
vocabulary.meaning: Value V is of quantity kind K (or, when its kind is undecided, K is one of its candidate kinds).

vocabulary.name: value_metric
vocabulary.meaning: Value V is a value of metric X (the quantity knowledge established it).

vocabulary.name: value_condition
vocabulary.meaning: Value V is stated under condition value X of axis A.

vocabulary.name: value_missing
vocabulary.meaning: The quantity knowledge requires axis A for V's metric, and V does not state it.

vocabulary.name: value_product
vocabulary.meaning: Value V is attributed to product P.

vocabulary.name: measurement
vocabulary.meaning: M is a taught measurement of the category.

vocabulary.name: measures
vocabulary.meaning: Taught measurement M measures quantity kind K; L = head (named in the concept's name) or body (only mentioned in its statement).

vocabulary.name: measures_metric
vocabulary.meaning: Taught measurement M measures metric X; L = head or body, as for measures.

vocabulary.name: fixes
vocabulary.meaning: The concept's name fixes condition value X of axis A ("at sleep mode": fan_setting = sleep).

vocabulary.name: requires_axis
vocabulary.meaning: Measurement M needs axis A stated to be interpreted (from its name or its requires_condition relations).

vocabulary.name: leads_to
vocabulary.meaning: A measured_by relation: M bears on outcome O with force F (direct, partial, unverified), per the source verification.

vocabulary.name: indirect_for
vocabulary.meaning: A not_sufficient_for relation: M is only an indirect indicator of outcome O.

vocabulary.name: names_metric
vocabulary.meaning: M names some metric at level L.

vocabulary.name: metric_conflict
vocabulary.meaning: V is a value of a metric that M does not measure, although M names the metrics it measures.

vocabulary.name: head_match
vocabulary.meaning: V matches what M's name says it measures (metric, or kind without a conflicting metric).

vocabulary.name: cand
vocabulary.meaning: M is a candidate measurement for V at level L: metric (same metric, named), kind (same kind, named), mention (same metric, only mentioned).

vocabulary.name: shows_fixed
vocabulary.meaning: V states one of the condition values M fixes on axis A.

vocabulary.name: unshown
vocabulary.meaning: M fixes a condition value that V does not state (linking V to M would assume it).

vocabulary.name: preferred
vocabulary.meaning: M is a candidate for V at level L whose fixed conditions V states.

vocabulary.name: has_pref
vocabulary.meaning: V has a preferred candidate at level L.

vocabulary.name: chosen
vocabulary.meaning: M is among the most specific preferred candidates for V.

vocabulary.name: any_pref
vocabulary.meaning: V has a preferred candidate at some level.

vocabulary.name: assumed
vocabulary.meaning: V has no preferred candidate, and M is a candidate that would assume an unstated condition.

vocabulary.name: rival
vocabulary.meaning: Another chosen candidate competes with M for V.

vocabulary.name: rival_assumed
vocabulary.meaning: Another assumed candidate competes with M for V.

vocabulary.name: linked
vocabulary.meaning: V is linked to M; S = shown (every condition M fixes is stated) or condition_not_shown (the only candidate assumes one).

vocabulary.name: differs
vocabulary.meaning: M1 bears on an outcome, with a force, that M2 does not: linking to one or the other has different consequences.

vocabulary.name: consequential
vocabulary.meaning: V's competing candidates have different consequences.

vocabulary.name: linked_equivalent
vocabulary.meaning: V's competing candidates all have the same consequences; V is linked to each of them (the choice is immaterial for decisions).

vocabulary.name: ambiguous
vocabulary.meaning: M is one of V's competing candidates with different consequences: V is not linked.

vocabulary.name: has_cand
vocabulary.meaning: V has a candidate measurement.

vocabulary.name: no_taught_measurement
vocabulary.meaning: No taught measurement of the category measures what V is: the teaching does not cover it (a knowledge gap, not an error).

vocabulary.name: value_has_axis
vocabulary.meaning: V states some value of axis A.

vocabulary.name: deciding_axis
vocabulary.meaning: A candidate of the ambiguous V fixes axis A and V does not state A: stating it would decide.

vocabulary.name: link_to
vocabulary.meaning: Given to evidence: V is linked to M (linked or linked_equivalent).

vocabulary.name: assumes_condition
vocabulary.meaning: Given to evidence: the link of V to M assumes a condition V does not state.

vocabulary.name: missing_axis
vocabulary.meaning: M needs axis A, and V does not state it.

vocabulary.name: conditions_ok
vocabulary.meaning: Every axis M needs is stated by V, and the link assumes nothing.

vocabulary.name: evidence_force
vocabulary.meaning: Through M, V bears on outcome O with force F: direct, partial, unverified, indirect, or conditions_not_shown (relevant, but cannot assess).

vocabulary.name: bears
vocabulary.meaning: Value V of product P bears on outcome O with force F through M.

vocabulary.name: has_direct
vocabulary.meaning: Some value of P is direct evidence on O.

vocabulary.name: contributes
vocabulary.meaning: A value of P measured by M contributes (partially) to assessing O.

vocabulary.name: has_contribution
vocabulary.meaning: Some value of P contributes to O.

vocabulary.name: two_contributions
vocabulary.meaning: Values of P from two different measurements contribute to O.

vocabulary.name: listed_contribution_missing
vocabulary.meaning: The teaching lists a contributing measurement of O that no value of P supplies.

vocabulary.name: complete_set
vocabulary.meaning: Values of P supply every contributing measurement the teaching lists for O, from at least two measurements.

vocabulary.name: has_indirect
vocabulary.meaning: Some value of P is an indirect indicator of O.

vocabulary.name: outcome_assessment
vocabulary.meaning: What the record allows about product P's outcome O: direct_evidence, all_listed_contributions, partial_contributions, indirect_only, force_not_verified or relevant_conditions_not_shown. Never a ranking by itself: authorisation also needs the user's need, the conditions of comparison and independent sources.

vocabulary.name: group_kind
vocabulary.meaning: Measurement M measures, as its measurand group G, quantity kind K (a set measures several groups: CADR, noise, power).

vocabulary.name: group_metric
vocabulary.meaning: Measurand group G of M is metric X.

vocabulary.name: observation
vocabulary.meaning: Value V reports original observation O. O is established only when V's test is identified (a named test or the protocol statement that covers it, within its source): O = source, test, product, property, value and conditions. Without a test identity no observation fact is given: neither equivalence nor independence is invented.

vocabulary.name: analytical_set
vocabulary.meaning: M is an analytical set: it relates several measurand groups (a CADR/noise/power curve), it is not a single measurement.

vocabulary.name: in_set
vocabulary.meaning: V's measured property is one of the measurands of the set M.

vocabulary.name: unshown_set
vocabulary.meaning: Membership of V in set M would assume a condition value V does not state.

vocabulary.name: member
vocabulary.meaning: V is a member of (contributes to) the analytical set M; membership is not exclusive and is not evidence of the set's relationship.

vocabulary.name: member_group
vocabulary.meaning: V is a member of set M as its measurand group G.

vocabulary.name: has_member
vocabulary.meaning: V is a member of some set.

vocabulary.name: member_only
vocabulary.meaning: V is a member of sets only: no single taught measurement describes it.

vocabulary.name: at
vocabulary.meaning: Value V of product P is set M's group G at value X of the axis A that M requires.

vocabulary.name: point_candidate
vocabulary.meaning: Some member of set M for product P is stated at value X of axis A.

vocabulary.name: group_of
vocabulary.meaning: G is a measurand group of M.

vocabulary.name: has_at
vocabulary.meaning: P has a member of group G of M at X.

vocabulary.name: missing_group
vocabulary.meaning: At X, a measurand group of M has no member for P.

vocabulary.name: condition_clash
vocabulary.meaning: Two members of M for P at X state different values of a closed axis (values defined by the knowledge): documented incompatible observations.

vocabulary.name: aligned_point
vocabulary.meaning: Every measurand group of M has a member for P at the same value X of the required axis A, every member states every axis M requires, no stated condition differs, and compatibility is positively supported: B = same_test (one identified run), same_protocol (one identified procedure: compatibility does not require one run) or stated_method (every member states the same method). Sharing a document is not enough; missing information is never compatibility.

vocabulary.name: relationship_at_points
vocabulary.meaning: Set M's relationship for P is supported at two or more aligned points (a partial curve; not every setting).

vocabulary.name: set_evidence
vocabulary.meaning: Through an aligned point at X, set M bears on O for P with force F, bounded to that setting.

vocabulary.name: contrib_obs
vocabulary.meaning: Observation Ob is part of M's partial contribution to O for P.

vocabulary.name: dependent
vocabulary.meaning: M1's and M2's contributions to O for P share an observation: they are not independent.

vocabulary.name: repeated_report
vocabulary.meaning: V1 and V2 report the same original observation.

vocabulary.name: value_source
vocabulary.meaning: Value V comes from source document S.

vocabulary.name: incomplete
vocabulary.meaning: The translation of M is incomplete: its name holds words the quantity knowledge cannot type (part of its procedure is unknown to PEE).

vocabulary.name: compatibility_not_shown
vocabulary.meaning: Every group of M has a member at X and nothing documents an incompatibility, but compatibility is not positively supported (no common test identity, no common stated method, or a required axis unstated): no relationship, no force.

vocabulary.name: unresolved_force
vocabulary.meaning: The relation M -> O is direct, but M's translation is incomplete: whether V suffices is unknown. Its force is unresolved, neither direct nor shown partial.

vocabulary.name: closed_axis
vocabulary.meaning: Axis A has a closed list of values in the quantity knowledge: two different values are different by definition.

vocabulary.name: condition_unequal
vocabulary.meaning: Two members of M for P at X state different free-text values of an axis (two method descriptions): neither shown equal nor shown different.

vocabulary.name: value_test
vocabulary.meaning: Value V comes from identified test run T (one execution of an experiment), within its source. A protocol or a named test procedure is not a run.

vocabulary.name: has_test
vocabulary.meaning: V's test is identified.

vocabulary.name: test_missing
vocabulary.meaning: A member of M for P at X has no identified test.

vocabulary.name: test_differs
vocabulary.meaning: Members of M for P at X come from different identified tests.

vocabulary.name: method_missing
vocabulary.meaning: A member of M for P at X states no method.

vocabulary.name: axis_unstated
vocabulary.meaning: A member of M for P at X does not state an axis M requires.

vocabulary.name: aligned_any
vocabulary.meaning: Some positive basis aligns the point.

vocabulary.name: identity_unknown
vocabulary.meaning: V's observation identity cannot be established (no identified test).

vocabulary.name: independence_not_established
vocabulary.meaning: A contribution to O for P rests on a value whose observation identity is unknown: independence cannot be shown.

vocabulary.name: has_unresolved
vocabulary.meaning: Some evidence on O for P has unresolved force.

vocabulary.name: operating_axis
vocabulary.meaning: Axis A is an operating condition (a setting, a programme): the axis along which a set's points are aligned.

vocabulary.name: value_protocol
vocabulary.meaning: Value V was obtained with procedure Q (the protocol statement that covers it, or the named test procedure), within its source. A procedure is shared by many runs: it supports compatibility, never identity.

vocabulary.name: protocol_missing
vocabulary.meaning: A member of M for P at X has no identified procedure.

vocabulary.name: protocol_differs
vocabulary.meaning: Members of M for P at X were obtained with different identified procedures.

vocabulary.name: has_protocol
vocabulary.meaning: V's procedure is identified.

vocabulary.name: matched_at
vocabulary.meaning: Preferred candidate M at level L fixes a condition value that V states (it explains more of what V states).

vocabulary.name: has_matched_at
vocabulary.meaning: Some preferred candidate of V at level L fixes a condition value V states.

vocabulary.name: best_pref
vocabulary.meaning: M is among the most specific preferred candidates of V at level L: one whose fixed condition V states, or any when none does.

vocabulary.name: partition_axis
vocabulary.meaning: Two candidates of V fix different values of axis A and V states none: A decides between them.

vocabulary.name: undecided
vocabulary.meaning: V's candidates are partitioned by an axis V does not state.

vocabulary.name: partition_member
vocabulary.meaning: M is a candidate of V that fixes a value of the partitioning axis.

vocabulary.name: contradicted
vocabulary.meaning: V states an axis that candidate M fixes to other values.

vocabulary.name: unread_qualifier
vocabulary.meaning: The measurand part of M's name (before by/at/per...) holds a word the quantity knowledge cannot type: a qualifier of what is measured that PEE cannot check.

programs.statement: Typed link of values to taught measurements.

rules.statement: A measurement names a metric.
A value of one metric does not belong to a measurement whose name names other metrics only.
Same metric, named by the measurement.
Same kind, named by the measurement, and no conflicting metric.
Candidate at the metric level. (single measurements only; sets take members, L31-L35)

rules.rule: cand(V,M,kind) :- value_kind(V,K), measures(M,K,head), not metric_conflict(V,M), not analytical_set(M).
rules.statement: Candidate at the kind level. (single measurements only; sets take members, L31-L35)

rules.rule: cand(V,M,mention) :- value_metric(V,X), measures_metric(M,X,body), not head_match(V,M), not analytical_set(M).
rules.statement: Candidate only because the measurement's statement mentions the value's metric (the weakest level). (single measurements only; sets take members, L31-L35)
V states one of the values M fixes on axis A.
Linking would assume a condition the value does not state: M fixes axis A and V states none of the values M fixes on A (several fixed values on one axis are alternatives: "dust and pollen CADR").
A candidate that assumes nothing.
V has a preferred candidate at level L.

rules.rule: matched_at(V,M,L) :- preferred(V,M,L), fixes(M,A,X), value_condition(V,A,X), not unread_qualifier(M).
rules.statement: A candidate whose fixed condition the value states, and whose measurand PEE can type completely (a match on one condition does not identify a candidate whose measurand carries a qualifier PEE cannot check, such as a label or a plug-side measurement).
rules.source: R3 (owner S73): most specific consistent candidate

rules.statement: Some candidate at level L is matched by a stated condition.
rules.source: R3 (owner S73): most specific consistent candidate

rules.statement: Most specific: the stated condition matches the candidate's fixed condition.
rules.source: R3 (owner S73): most specific consistent candidate

rules.statement: When no candidate at the level is matched by a stated condition, every preferred one stays.
rules.source: R3 (owner S73): most specific consistent candidate

rules.rule: contradicted(V,M) :- cand(V,M,_), fixes(M,A,_), value_has_axis(V,A), not shows_fixed(V,M,A).
rules.statement: The value states axis A, and candidate M fixes A to other values: M is not what V measured.
rules.source: R3 dev review (p272 regressions): partition and specificity only among candidates consistent with the value and fully described

rules.rule: partition_axis(V,A) :- cand(V,M1,_), cand(V,M2,_), M1 != M2, fixes(M1,A,X1), fixes(M2,A,X2), X1 != X2, not value_has_axis(V,A), not contradicted(V,M1), not contradicted(V,M2).
rules.statement: Candidates fixing different values of one axis the value does not state: the axis is the question that decides, and no candidate wins by elimination (a third candidate that fixes nothing is not thereby more likely).
rules.source: R3: a condition that partitions the candidates is the deciding question

rules.statement: V is undecided between the partitioned candidates.
rules.source: R3: a condition that partitions the candidates is the deciding question

rules.rule: partition_member(V,M) :- partition_axis(V,A), cand(V,M,_), fixes(M,A,_), not contradicted(V,M).
rules.statement: The candidates the axis partitions.
rules.source: R3: a condition that partitions the candidates is the deciding question

rules.statement: The metric level is the most specific.
rules.source: R3 (owner S73): most specific consistent candidate

rules.rule: chosen(V,M) :- best_pref(V,M,kind), not has_pref(V,metric), not undecided(V).
rules.statement: The kind level, when no metric-level candidate assumes nothing.
rules.source: R3 (owner S73): most specific consistent candidate

rules.rule: chosen(V,M) :- best_pref(V,M,mention), not has_pref(V,metric), not has_pref(V,kind), not undecided(V).
rules.statement: A mention, only when nothing more specific exists.
rules.source: R3 (owner S73): most specific consistent candidate

rules.statement: An undecided value keeps the partitioned candidates as rivals (ambiguous, with the deciding axis).
rules.source: R3: a condition that partitions the candidates is the deciding question

rules.statement: V has some preferred candidate.
When every candidate assumes an unstated condition, they are kept as such.
Two chosen candidates compete.
A single chosen candidate is the link.
Two assumed candidates compete.
A single candidate that assumes a condition is a link that cannot assess (the evidence program grades it so).
Two measurements differ in consequence when one bears on an outcome, with a force, that the other does not.
The competition matters for decisions.
The competition matters for decisions (assumed candidates).

rules.rule: linked_equivalent(V,M) :- chosen(V,M), rival(V,M), not consequential(V), not undecided(V).
rules.statement: Competing candidates with the same consequences: the choice is immaterial; V is linked to each. Not when an unstated axis partitions the candidates: equal consequences do not make values measured under different conditions comparable.

rules.rule: linked_equivalent(V,M) :- assumed(V,M), rival_assumed(V,M), not consequential(V), not undecided(V).
rules.statement: As L23, for assumed candidates.
Competing candidates with different consequences: no link.
As L25, for assumed candidates.
An unstated axis that partitions the candidates leaves V ambiguous between them, whatever their consequences: the axis is the question to answer.
rules.source: R3 dev review (p272 regressions): partition and specificity only among candidates consistent with the value and fully described

rules.statement: V has a candidate.

rules.rule: no_taught_measurement(V) :- value(V), not has_cand(V), not has_member(V).
rules.statement: Closed over the teaching view: no taught measurement measures what V is. The teaching does not cover it; the value is not wrong.
V states axis A.
Stating axis A would tell the candidates apart.
A measurement of several measurand groups is an analytical set.
Same metric as one of the set's measurands.

rules.rule: in_set(V,M) :- analytical_set(M), value_kind(V,K), measures(M,K,head), not metric_conflict(V,M).
rules.statement: Same kind as one of the set's measurands.
Membership would assume an unstated condition.
A member of every compatible set: one observation may serve several analyses.
The group the member fills.
The group the member fills (by metric).
V is a member of some set.
Only sets cover V.
One observation reported twice.
No identified test: identity unknown (not merged, not independent).

programs.statement: Graded evidential force of linked values, and what it allows per product and outcome.

rules.statement: V states axis A.
A condition the measurement needs is not stated with the value.
A condition the value's own metric requires is not stated.

rules.rule: conditions_ok(V,M) :- link_to(V,M), not missing_axis(V,M,_), not assumes_condition(V,M).
rules.statement: Every needed condition is stated and nothing is assumed.

rules.rule: evidence_force(V,O,F,M) :- link_to(V,M), leads_to(M,O,F), conditions_ok(V,M), F != direct.
rules.statement: The value carries the relation's verified force (partial or unverified), bounded to its measurement and conditions.

rules.rule: evidence_force(V,O,direct,M) :- link_to(V,M), leads_to(M,O,direct), conditions_ok(V,M), not incomplete(M).
rules.statement: Direct force only when PEE can read the whole measurement (its translation is complete).
A direct relation through a measurement PEE cannot fully read: whether this value suffices is unknown.
Unresolved force: neither direct nor shown partial (incomplete translation does not make a contribution partial).
Relevant to the outcome, but without its conditions it cannot assess it.
The teaching says this measurement is only an indirect indicator of the outcome.
Evidence about product P.
P has direct evidence on O.
A direct measurement of the outcome, under its conditions.
A partial contribution, by measurement.
P has a contribution to O.

rules.rule: two_contributions(P,O) :- contributes(P,O,M1), contributes(P,O,M2), M1 != M2, not dependent(P,O,M1,M2).
rules.statement: Contributions from two different measurements that share no observation (repeated use of one observation is not independent corroboration).
Closed over the record: a contributing measurement the teaching lists is not supplied for P.

rules.rule: complete_set(P,O) :- two_contributions(P,O), not listed_contribution_missing(P,O), not independence_not_established(P,O).
rules.statement: Every listed contributing measurement is supplied, from at least two measurements whose independence is established.
The set the teaching lists is present. It assesses O only as far as that list is complete, which the teaching does not prove; independence of sources is not checked here (one document).
Some contributions only: O is partly assessed.
P has an indirect indicator of O.

rules.rule: outcome_assessment(P,O,indirect_only) :- has_indirect(P,O), not has_direct(P,O), not has_contribution(P,O).
rules.statement: Only indirect indicators: never an assessment.
The relation's force was never verified against its source.
Relevant values whose conditions are not stated.
A member alone is a component of the set's analysis: it establishes neither the relationship nor the outcome.

rules.rule: at(P,M,G,A,X,V) :- member_group(V,M,G), value_product(V,P), requires_axis(M,A), operating_axis(A), value_condition(V,A,X).
rules.statement: Members placed by the operating setting the set requires (other required conditions must be stated, E28l, not aligned on).
A setting where some member exists.
The set's groups.
A group filled at X.
Closed over the record: a group has no member at X.

rules.rule: condition_clash(P,M,A,X) :- at(P,M,_,A,X,V1), at(P,M,_,A,X,V2), value_condition(V1,B,Y1), value_condition(V2,B,Y2), Y1 != Y2, closed_axis(B).
rules.statement: Members stating different values of a closed axis (a different challenge pollutant) are documented incompatible.

rules.rule: condition_unequal(P,M,A,X) :- at(P,M,_,A,X,V1), at(P,M,_,A,X,V2), value_condition(V1,B,Y1), value_condition(V2,B,Y2), Y1 != Y2, not closed_axis(B).
rules.statement: Different free-text values (two method descriptions, a filter state) are not shown different, and not shown equal (unknown is not different, R1).
V's test is identified.
A member without an identified test.

rules.rule: test_differs(P,M,A,X) :- at(P,M,_,A,X,V1), at(P,M,_,A,X,V2), value_test(V1,T1), value_test(V2,T2), T1 != T2.
rules.statement: Members from different identified tests.
A member without a stated method.
A member that does not state an axis the set requires (relevant operating and test conditions).

rules.rule: aligned_point(P,M,A,X,same_test) :- point_candidate(P,M,A,X), not missing_group(P,M,A,X), not condition_clash(P,M,A,X), not condition_unequal(P,M,A,X), not axis_unstated(P,M,A,X), not test_missing(P,M,A,X), not test_differs(P,M,A,X).
rules.statement: Every group from one identified test at the same setting, every required condition stated and none differing: compatibility positively supported by the common test.

rules.rule: aligned_point(P,M,A,X,stated_method) :- point_candidate(P,M,A,X), not missing_group(P,M,A,X), not condition_clash(P,M,A,X), not condition_unequal(P,M,A,X), not axis_unstated(P,M,A,X), not method_missing(P,M,A,X).
rules.statement: Every member states the same method (a different one is condition_unequal) and every required condition: compatibility positively supported by the method, across sources or tests.
V's procedure is identified.
A member without an identified procedure.

rules.rule: protocol_differs(P,M,A,X) :- at(P,M,_,A,X,V1), at(P,M,_,A,X,V2), value_protocol(V1,Q1), value_protocol(V2,Q2), Q1 != Q2.
rules.statement: Members obtained with different procedures.

rules.rule: aligned_point(P,M,A,X,same_protocol) :- point_candidate(P,M,A,X), not missing_group(P,M,A,X), not condition_clash(P,M,A,X), not condition_unequal(P,M,A,X), not axis_unstated(P,M,A,X), not protocol_missing(P,M,A,X), not protocol_differs(P,M,A,X).
rules.statement: One identified procedure, every required condition stated, none differing: compatibility positively supported (one run is not required, S69).
Aligned on some basis.

rules.rule: compatibility_not_shown(P,M,A,X) :- point_candidate(P,M,A,X), not missing_group(P,M,A,X), not condition_clash(P,M,A,X), not aligned_any(P,M,A,X).
rules.statement: Nothing documents an incompatibility, but nothing positively supports compatibility: explicit uncertainty, no relationship, no force (sharing a document is not a common protocol).
Two or more aligned points: a partial relationship across settings (not a complete curve).
The set's force applies to an aligned point only, bounded to its setting.
Direct force from an aligned point only when the set's translation is complete.
Unresolved force when part of the set's procedure is unread.
Observations behind a single measurement's contribution.
Observations behind a set point's contribution.
Contributions sharing an observation are not independent (NIST: shared data are correlated).
A contribution resting on a value of unknown identity cannot be shown independent of another.
As E33a, for a set point.
Direct evidence from an aligned point of a set.
A partial contribution from an aligned point of a set.
Unresolved evidence.
Unresolved evidence from a set point.

rules.rule: outcome_assessment(P,O,force_unresolved) :- has_unresolved(P,O), not has_direct(P,O), not has_contribution(P,O).
rules.statement: Relevant evidence whose force PEE cannot yet determine: an explicit abstention, never an assessment.
